**Target restore exclusion.** An already occupied section returns 503 `{error: "refused", detail: "a move is under way here already: seconds, not minutes"}` without pending/key/state/claim writes.

**Target restore exclusion.** Take holds it through spending pending, opening keys, all restore I/O and the final claim/Entry handling. Prepare holds it through its pending-key write; move holds it through its entire changing operation.

**Target restore exclusion.** A source call-off, HTTP timeout, disconnected caller or cancelled response does not release it while any old handler, submitted I/O or callback can still perform a restore write. Release only after that work has completed or cancellation has been joined so it cannot write; after release the old operation never resumes restore.
**Target restore exclusion.** This local exclusion does not replace the ordinary turn/CAS/unknown-outcome barrier, cryptographic validation, or restore-before-final-claim order.
